before_after.label: Credit = prosperity
before_after.after: FAILED BEHAVIORALLY — may mean more debt

progress_movement: Validation 33% → 50%. Overall 83% → 88%. Unabridged unchanged 100%. Behavioral attack: housing subsidy-without-supply FAILED; ordinary-humans lock SURVIVED; additionality/capture/pilot tests required. Next: Pass 4.4 Resilience & Adversarial Attack.
summary: Pass 4.3 attempts to falsify transmission assumptions. People and markets capture, offset, game, and fail to behave as hoped. Several slogans die. Guardrail tests survive. COUNTABLE remains $0.

what_changed_stage4.what_we_thought: Legal + fiscal clearance would largely settle household benefit claims.
what_changed_stage4.what_we_tested: Benefit capture, incidence, housing, healthcare, education, labor, entrepreneurship, public capital, procurement, retention, credit, external capital, migration, pilots, fiscal visibility, failure modes, distribution grid, market structure.
what_changed_stage4.what_evidence_said: Capitalization and incidence logic; moral hazard; selection bias; ordinary imperfect humans.
what_changed_stage4.what_survived: Ordinary-humans lock; Benefit Capture / Additionality / Capability Transfer / Pilot Transferability / Fiscal Visibility tests; five-scenario fragility rule.
what_changed_stage4.what_changed: Worker ownership requires risk disclosure + cash alternative; procurement needs graduation metrics; population needs capacity constraints.
what_changed_stage4.what_failed: Housing demand-side without supply; access without capacity; credit=prosperity; buy-local moral premium; pilot→statewide leap; public capital without additionality; worker-ownership-as-always-good.
what_changed_stage4.what_remains_unknown: Microsim binds; energy/childcare/wealth series; CTE surplus evidence; elasticities.
